label: supersedes
type: subject = a newer mechanism/feature the docs position as the preferred way to achieve what an older mechanism/feature (object) did; means the docs recommend the subject going forward. Does NOT assert the object is deprecated, removed, or no longer functional - only that a page states the subject as a simpler/better alternative to it. Deliberately weaker than deprecatedIn (which requires the docs to state the object itself has been declared deprecated) and distinct from takesPrecedenceOver (which is scoped to a setting/value overriding a sibling setting/value when both are set on the same object, not to one whole feature replacing another).
significance_exception: Promoted below the usual recurrence-2 bar, following round 24's alsoExposedAs precedent for a predicate minted to carry the sharpest evidence for a headline finding rather than for its own recurrence. Round 28's coordinator-level ISGR-vs-XDCR question turns on exactly this fact - Sync Gateway 4.0's native bi-directional XDCR (sgw:bidirectional-xdcr) is documented as replacing Inter-Sync Gateway Replication (sgw:inter-sync-gateway-replication) for active-active mobile topologies - and no existing predicate's declared range fits it without a stretch. Corrects a mis-fit at write time: server-compatibility-xdcr.json originally filed this fact under the already-promoted takesPrecedenceOver, whose own type is scoped to settings/config values, not features; retargeted here during reconciliation with the same evidence quote.
note: First instance: sgw:bidirectional-xdcr supersedes sgw:inter-sync-gateway-replication. Evidence: 'Sync Gateway 4.0 introduces native bi-directional XDCR support for active-active mobile clusters, providing a simpler and more efficient alternative to Inter-Sync Gateway Replication' (server-compatibility-xdcr.md). Deliberately does not retract or edit sgw:inter-sync-gateway-replication's own promoted record - ISGR is not stated to be deprecated or removed, and 4 of the round's 5 dedicated ISGR pages continue to document it in full as a live feature with no forward-pointer to bi-directional XDCR at all. Reserve deprecatedIn/removedIn for ISGR only if a future page states either outright.
